summary: StoneCo Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, announcing the filing of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the SEC. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure of annual financial results and operational updates, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. No transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. As a standard annual regulatory filing, this does not constitute a special situation.
